datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Mauritania to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic classifications were compiled into spatial datasets for October, November, and December 2020, representing population-level food security outcomes driven by drought and other livelihood stressors.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications reflect acute food insecurity outcomes driven by underlying hazards including drought and livelihood disruption.
